<header class="page-heading"><p class="eyebrow">District Court starter template</p><h1>Subpoena Request / Proposed Process</h1><p>Use this starter filing to identify the process requested, the person or materials sought, and the connection to the pending case.</p></header>

<article class="filing-template">
  <p class="filing-template__notice"><strong>Template use.</strong> This is a request/proposed-process format, not self-executing process. A subpoena or other compulsory process is effective only when issued or authorized in the manner required by the Court.</p>
  <div class="filing-template__document">
    <div class="filing-template__caption"><p><strong>UNITED STATES DISTRICT COURT</strong></p><p><strong>DISTRICT OF COLUMBIA</strong></p><h2>[CASE CAPTION]</h2><p>Case No. [DOCKET NUMBER]</p></div>
    <h2>REQUEST FOR ISSUANCE OF [SUBPOENA / PROCESS]</h2>
    <div class="filing-template__field"><strong>Requested recipient</strong><span class="template-placeholder">[Person / office / custodian]</span></div>
    <div class="filing-template__field"><strong>Appearance or production sought</strong><span class="template-placeholder">[Testimony, document category, record, or other material]</span></div>
    <div class="filing-template__field"><strong>Requested date / deadline</strong><span class="template-placeholder">[If applicable]</span></div>
    <section class="filing-template__section"><h3>Relevance to proceeding</h3><p class="template-placeholder">[Briefly explain why the testimony or materials are sought in this case.]</p></section>
    <section class="filing-template__section"><h3>Requested action</h3><p class="template-placeholder">[Ask the Court to issue, authorize, or approve the proposed process as appropriate.]</p></section>
    <section class="filing-template__section"><h3>Respectfully submitted</h3><p class="template-placeholder">[Name]<br>[Party / office / counsel status]<br>[Date]</p></section>
  </div>
</article>
